title: Hong Kong 100 – Introduction
claims: Hong Kong 100 is a trail running event held in Hong Kong whose courses start in the Sai Kung Peninsula.
The HK100 course is based on the MacLehose Trail, with diversions that take runners through its most scenic sections, and finishes with the descent from Tai Mo Shan, Hong Kong's highest peak.
The event weekend includes HK100, The Half and The Third, and runners can enter The Grand Sam to take on all three distances over three consecutive days.
The Third finishes with a climb up to Tai Cham Koi, which gives a 360-degree panoramic view of the Sai Kung Peninsula.
The page lists all three physical events as part of the ITRA National League for 2026.
